lines: The floor of this one has been ruled into four squares with a cross of laid stone.
There is no wall in it anywhere. There is a plan on the ground, and you are standing in it.

$comment:
THE MASTER OF CONTROL. Same shape as all four: she stands on the one walkable neighbour of the door out, she heals the party herself before the fight, a loss is `continue` and re-arms this conversation from the same tile, and beating her removes the blocker live rather than waiting for a map reload -- NPC visibility flags are only read in loadMap, so a script that sets the flag and stops leaves the player shut in with a man who is no longer there.

HER HEAL IS THE OPPOSITE OF CARRICK'S IN THE SAME WORDS. He does it so the argument is honest; she does it so nobody can say afterwards that anything was arranged. Same courtesy, two philosophies, and it costs one box each.

lines: Serra Lowe. There is a chair. Nobody has ever sat in it and I have stopped moving it out.
You are standing on the middle square, by the way. Everybody does. It is the worst one.
She fills a bowl at the sill and sets it down on the ruled line without being asked.
Your party was restored.
Whole, please. I would rather nobody was ever able to say they were tired.
It would spoil the only interesting thing about losing to me.
Nothing I do in the next few minutes is going to look like an attack.
You will lose anyway, and you will not be able to say afterwards precisely when.
Whenever you are ready.
Thank you. Stand wherever you like; I have already decided where you will be.
Sensible. Go and look at the shelves on your way out - the left-hand ones.
They are openings, not results. It is the same information and it is much more useful.
She takes a pencil out of her coat, writes for about four seconds, and puts it away again.
She does not look at the page while she is doing it.
There. That was the moment. You went faster than I could get things into place.
Eleven people. Eleven times, the same way, and I keep writing it down as though it will change.
Serra Lowe handed over 2 Full Heals.
Two Full Heals. I have just spent ten minutes showing you what they are for.
Do not save them for the Champion. Save them for the turn you notice.
Moss is above me. Do not try to out-think him - he does not think, he moves.
That is not a criticism. I have never been able to do it and I have watched him for thirty years.
She goes and sits at the east table, at the chair that is not square with anything.
It is the only place in the room she has ever put anything crooked, and it is where she sits.
About turn nine. It was finished then and neither of us said anything about it.
That is not a criticism either. Almost nobody notices at the time.
Go down, put them right, and come back and do it in three.
The bowl will be on the sill. It is always on the sill.
Abel swings. I set the table. He has decided that makes me the unkind one.
He has never once considered that I finish faster than he does.
I have written down every first move anybody has made in this room for thirty years.
Yours is on the eleventh shelf now, with the spines turned in. You will never see it.
